entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source Bitcoin education website founded in 2022. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education.
entries.targetTranslation: bitcoin.rocks jẹ́ ojú-ìwé ẹ̀kọ́ Bitcoin ọ̀fẹ́, orísun-ṣíṣí tí a dá sílẹ̀ ní 2022. Ètò wa ni láti yára ìgbàfẹ́ Bitcoin nípasẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò ní owó-ṣíṣẹ́

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Owó-ṣíṣẹ́ túmọ̀ sí pé owó rẹ ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí bí àkókò ti ń lọ. Bitcoin jẹ́ owó tí ó dára jùlọ nítorí kò ní owó-ṣíṣẹ́.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: nítorí ó ní ìpèsè tó ga jùlọ tí 21 mílíọ̀nù Bitcoin. Kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó lè tẹ̀ Bitcoin síi.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: dọ́là ní ìpèsè aláìlópin, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé a lè tẹ̀ síi ní àkókò èyíkéyìí.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò pọ̀ tó

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní ìtàn àtẹ̀hìnwá, Bitcoin ti ní agbára-rírà síi pẹ̀lú àkókò, nígbà tí dọ́là ti pàdánù tirẹ̀. Ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ń lo Bitcoin gẹ́gẹ́ bí àpótí ìfowópamọ́ ọdún púpọ̀: owó tí wọ́n lè fi sílẹ̀, kí ó sì máa dàgbà lórí àkókò ọdún.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣé ìwọ yóò fẹ́ pa owó mọ́ ní dọ́là tí ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí pẹ̀lú àkókò? Tàbí pa owó mọ́ ní Bitcoin tí ó ti ń ra ohun tí ó pọ̀ sí pẹ̀lú àkókò ní ìtàn?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tún jẹ́ ohun-èlò fún òmìnira

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Ẹnikẹ́ni kò ní nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Bitcoin. Kò sí ìjọba tàbí ilé-iṣẹ́ kankan tí ó ń darí rẹ̀. A ṣẹ̀dá rẹ̀ láti dáàbò bo òmìnira àti owó rẹ.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ènìyàn ní gbogbo àgbáyé ti ń lo Bitcoin láti dáàbò bo òmìnira wọn — kódà nígbà tí ìjọba ará wọn kọ̀ láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ tàbí gbìyànjú láti dí wọn lọ́wọ́.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Tí o bá ń pa owó dọ́là Ọsirélíà mọ́, ó ṣeé ṣe kí o ti ṣàkíyèsí pé ó ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún. Ó nílò dọ́là púpọ̀ síi láti ra iye oúnjẹ kan náà. O nílò dọ́là púpọ̀ síi láti pa ìpele ìgbé ayé rẹ mọ́.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣùgbọ́n kò sì gbọ́dọ̀ rí bẹ́ẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn tí ó ti pa Bitcoin mọ́ ní ọdún mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn ti rí i pé iye ìgbé ayé wọn ti dín kù.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Èyí ni ẹ̀rí náà: owó rẹ ń pàdánù iye rẹ̀

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: dọ́là tí ó wà ní àpótí ilé-ìfowópamọ́ rẹ ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún, nítorí kò sí ààlà tí ó múlẹ̀ lórí iye dọ́là tí a lè ṣẹ̀dá.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Àìní ààlà yìí ni ìdí pàtàkì ti owó-ṣíṣẹ́. Ní àwọn ọdún díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn, iye àpapọ̀ dọ́là tí ó wà ti pọ̀ sí gan-an.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí a ti ń ṣẹ̀dá owó síi láti ihò òfo, idiyele ohun gbogbo ń pọ̀ sí, pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun èlò tí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ń rà láti ṣe àwọn ohun tí o ń rà. Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé idiyele tí o ń sanwó nígbẹ̀yìn yóò tún pọ̀ sí.

entries.englishValue: And when the government continues to increase their debt, even more money is printed because less people want to lend them money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí àwọn ìjọba ti ń pọ̀ sí gbèsè wọn, owó síi á di títẹ̀ jáde, nítorí pé àwọn ènìyàn díẹ̀ ni yóò fi yá wọn.

entries.englishValue: , they just print the money.
entries.targetTranslation: , wọ́n máa kàn tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde fúnra wọn.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò pọ̀ tó

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní ìtàn àtẹ̀hìnwá, Bitcoin ti ní agbára-rírà síi pẹ̀lú àkókò, nígbà tí dọ́là ti pàdánù tirẹ̀. Ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ń lo Bitcoin gẹ́gẹ́ bí àpótí ìfowópamọ́ ọdún púpọ̀: owó tí wọ́n lè fi sílẹ̀, kí ó sì máa dàgbà lórí àkókò ọdún.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣé ìwọ yóò fẹ́ pa owó mọ́ ní dọ́là tí ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí pẹ̀lú àkókò? Tàbí pa owó mọ́ ní Bitcoin tí ó ti ń ra ohun tí ó pọ̀ sí pẹ̀lú àkókò ní ìtàn?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tún jẹ́ ohun-èlò fún òmìnira

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Ẹnikẹ́ni kò ní nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Bitcoin. Kò sí ìjọba tàbí ilé-iṣẹ́ kankan tí ó ń darí rẹ̀. A ṣẹ̀dá rẹ̀ láti dáàbò bo òmìnira àti owó rẹ.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ènìyàn ní gbogbo àgbáyé ti ń lo Bitcoin láti dáàbò bo òmìnira wọn — kódà nígbà tí ìjọba ará wọn kọ̀ láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ tàbí gbìyànjú láti dí wọn lọ́wọ́.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Canadian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Tí o bá ń pa owó dọ́là Kánádà mọ́, ó ṣeé ṣe kí o ti ṣàkíyèsí pé ó ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún. Ó nílò dọ́là púpọ̀ síi láti ra iye oúnjẹ kan náà. O nílò dọ́là púpọ̀ síi láti pa ìpele ìgbé ayé rẹ mọ́.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣùgbọ́n kò sì gbọ́dọ̀ rí bẹ́ẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn tí ó ti pa Bitcoin mọ́ ní ọdún mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn ti rí i pé iye ìgbé ayé wọn ti dín kù.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tún jẹ́ ohun-èlò fún òmìnira

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Ẹnikẹ́ni kò ní nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Bitcoin. Kò sí ìjọba tàbí ilé-iṣẹ́ kankan tí ó ń darí rẹ̀. A ṣẹ̀dá rẹ̀ láti dáàbò bo òmìnira àti owó rẹ.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ènìyàn ní gbogbo àgbáyé ti ń lo Bitcoin láti dáàbò bo òmìnira wọn — kódà nígbà tí ìjọba ará wọn kọ̀ láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ tàbí gbìyànjú láti dí wọn lọ́wọ́.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ènìyàn ní gbogbo àgbáyé ti ń lo Bitcoin láti dáàbò bo òmìnira wọn — kódà nígbà tí ìjọba ará wọn kọ̀ láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ tàbí gbìyànjú láti dí wọn lọ́wọ́.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Mexican Pesos, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more pesos to buy the same amount of food. You need more pesos to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Tí o bá ń pa owó pẹ́sò Mẹ́síkò mọ́, ó ṣeé ṣe kí o ti ṣàkíyèsí pé ó ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún. Ó nílò pẹ́sò púpọ̀ síi láti ra iye oúnjẹ kan náà. O nílò pẹ́sò púpọ̀ síi láti pa ìpele ìgbé ayé rẹ mọ́.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣùgbọ́n kò sì gbọ́dọ̀ rí bẹ́ẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn tí ó ti pa Bitcoin mọ́ ní ọdún mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn ti rí i pé iye ìgbé ayé wọn ti dín kù.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Èyí ni ẹ̀rí náà: owó rẹ ń pàdánù iye rẹ̀

entries.englishValue: The pesos in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many pesos can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: pẹ́sò tí ó wà ní àpótí ilé-ìfowópamọ́ rẹ ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún, nítorí kò sí ààlà tí ó múlẹ̀ lórí iye pẹ́sò tí a lè ṣẹ̀dá.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of pesos in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Àìní ààlà yìí ni ìdí pàtàkì ti owó-ṣíṣẹ́. Ní àwọn ọdún díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn, iye àpapọ̀ pẹ́sò tí ó wà ti pọ̀ sí gan-an.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí a ti ń ṣẹ̀dá owó síi láti ihò òfo, idiyele ohun gbogbo ń pọ̀ sí, pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun èlò tí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ń rà láti ṣe àwọn ohun tí o ń rà. Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé idiyele tí o ń sanwó nígbẹ̀yìn yóò tún pọ̀ sí.

entries.englishValue: And when the government continues to increase their debt, even more money is printed because less people want to lend them money.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí àwọn ìjọba ti ń pọ̀ sí gbèsè wọn, owó síi á di títẹ̀ jáde, nítorí pé àwọn ènìyàn díẹ̀ ni yóò fi yá wọn.

entries.englishValue: , they just print the money.
entries.targetTranslation: , wọ́n máa kàn tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde fúnra wọn.

entries.englishValue: If you can't get a loan, you can't spend money. But if the government
entries.targetTranslation: Tí o kò bá lè yá owó, o kò lè ná. Ṣùgbọ́n bí ìjọba bá

entries.englishValue: can't get a loan
entries.targetTranslation: kò lè yá

entries.englishValue: More government debt means more money printing. More money printing means more inflation. And there's no sign of it stopping.
entries.targetTranslation: Gbèsè ìjọba síi túmọ̀ sí títẹ̀ owó síi. Títẹ̀ owó síi túmọ̀ sí owó-ṣíṣẹ́ síi. Kò sì sí ààmì pé èyí yóò dúró.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò ní owó-ṣíṣẹ́

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Owó-ṣíṣẹ́ túmọ̀ sí pé owó rẹ ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí bí àkókò ti ń lọ. Bitcoin jẹ́ owó tí ó dára jùlọ nítorí kò ní owó-ṣíṣẹ́.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: nítorí ó ní ìpèsè tó ga jùlọ tí 21 mílíọ̀nù Bitcoin. Kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó lè tẹ̀ Bitcoin síi.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: dọ́là ní ìpèsè aláìlópin, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé a lè tẹ̀ síi ní àkókò èyíkéyìí.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò pọ̀ tó

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní ìtàn àtẹ̀hìnwá, Bitcoin ti ní agbára-rírà síi pẹ̀lú àkókò, nígbà tí dọ́là ti pàdánù tirẹ̀. Ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ń lo Bitcoin gẹ́gẹ́ bí àpótí ìfowópamọ́ ọdún púpọ̀: owó tí wọ́n lè fi sílẹ̀, kí ó sì máa dàgbà lórí àkókò ọdún.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣé ìwọ yóò fẹ́ pa owó mọ́ ní dọ́là tí ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí pẹ̀lú àkókò? Tàbí pa owó mọ́ ní Bitcoin tí ó ti ń ra ohun tí ó pọ̀ sí pẹ̀lú àkókò ní ìtàn?

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.

entries.englishValue: Baht have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò pọ̀ tó

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the baht has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní ìtàn àtẹ̀hìnwá, Bitcoin ti ní agbára-rírà síi pẹ̀lú àkókò, nígbà tí báàtì ti pàdánù tirẹ̀. Ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn ń lo Bitcoin gẹ́gẹ́ bí àpótí ìfowópamọ́ ọdún púpọ̀: owó tí wọ́n lè fi sílẹ̀, kí ó sì máa dàgbà lórí àkókò ọdún.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in baht that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣé ìwọ yóò fẹ́ pa owó mọ́ ní báàtì tí ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí pẹ̀lú àkókò? Tàbí pa owó mọ́ ní Bitcoin tí ó ti ń ra ohun tí ó pọ̀ sí pẹ̀lú àkókò ní ìtàn?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin tún jẹ́ ohun-èlò fún òmìnira

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Ẹnikẹ́ni kò ní nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Bitcoin. Kò sí ìjọba tàbí ilé-iṣẹ́ kankan tí ó ń darí rẹ̀. A ṣẹ̀dá rẹ̀ láti dáàbò bo òmìnira àti owó rẹ.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ènìyàn ní gbogbo àgbáyé ti ń lo Bitcoin láti dáàbò bo òmìnira wọn — kódà nígbà tí ìjọba ará wọn kọ̀ láti ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ tàbí gbìyànjú láti dí wọn lọ́wọ́.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Thai Baht, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more baht to buy the same amount of food. You need more baht to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Tí o bá ń pa owó báàtì Tailandi mọ́, ó ṣeé ṣe kí o ti ṣàkíyèsí pé ó ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún. Ó nílò báàtì púpọ̀ síi láti ra iye oúnjẹ kan náà. O nílò báàtì púpọ̀ síi láti pa ìpele ìgbé ayé rẹ mọ́.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣùgbọ́n kò sì gbọ́dọ̀ rí bẹ́ẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn tí ó ti pa Bitcoin mọ́ ní ọdún mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn ti rí i pé iye ìgbé ayé wọn ti dín kù.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value
entries.targetTranslation: Èyí ni ẹ̀rí náà: owó rẹ ń pàdánù iye rẹ̀

entries.englishValue: The baht in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many baht can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: báàtì tí ó wà ní àpótí ilé-ìfowópamọ́ rẹ ń ra ohun tí ó kéré sí ní ọdọọdún, nítorí kò sí ààlà tí ó múlẹ̀ lórí iye báàtì tí a lè ṣẹ̀dá.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of baht in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Àìní ààlà yìí ni ìdí pàtàkì ti owó-ṣíṣẹ́. Ní àwọn ọdún díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn, iye àpapọ̀ báàtì tí ó wà ti pọ̀ sí gan-an.

entries.targetTranslation: Bí a ti ń ṣẹ̀dá owó síi láti ihò òfo, idiyele ohun gbogbo ń pọ̀ sí, pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun èlò tí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ń rà láti ṣe àwọn ohun tí o ń rà. Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé idiyele tí o ń sanwó nígbẹ̀yìn yóò tún pọ̀ sí.

entries.targetTranslation: Bí àwọn ìjọba ti ń pọ̀ sí gbèsè wọn, owó síi á di títẹ̀ jáde, nítorí pé àwọn ènìyàn díẹ̀ ni yóò fi yá wọn.

entries.englishValueBefore: - no one can deny you access. Banks, however, can refuse to open accounts, freeze existing accounts, or deny services based on their policies or government regulations.
entries.englishValue: Banks can refuse, freeze, or close accounts based on policy or government rules.
entries.currentValue: - kò sí ẹ̀níkan tó lè kọ ọ́ lénu ònà. Àwọn ilé-ìfòwópàmó́, ṣùgbọ́n, lè kọ̀ láti ṣí ààkósílẹ̀, dí àwọn ààkósílẹ̀ tó wà, tàbí kọ láti pèṣè iṣẹ́ dá lórí àwọn òfìn wọn tàbí àwọn ofìn ìkálẹ̀.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ lè kọ̀, dí, tàbí pa àwọn àpótí mọ́ dá lórí ìlànà tàbí òfin ìjọba.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year without maintenance windows or holidays. Banks have limited operating hours, close on weekends and holidays, and often have system maintenance periods when services are unavailable.
entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network runs 24/7/365 with no maintenance windows or holidays. Banks have limited hours, weekends off, and outage windows.
entries.currentValue: Nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Bitcoin máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ wàkàtí 24 ní ọ̀jọ́ kan, ọ̀jọ́ 7 ní ọ̀sẹ̀ kan, ọ̀jọ́ 365 ní ọ̀dún kan láì ní àkókó ìtòjú tàbí àwọn ọ̀jọ́ iṣẹ́. Àwọn ilé-ìfòwópàmó́ ní wàkàtí iṣẹ́ tó lópin, máa ń ti tàbí ní àwọn ọ̀jọ́ iṣẹ́ àti àwọn àkókó ìtòjú ètò.
entries.targetTranslation: Nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Bitcoin ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní 24/7/365 láìní àkókò ìtọ́jú tàbí ìsinmi. Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ ní àkókò tí ó tóóró, ìsinmi ọjọ́ òpin ọ̀sẹ̀, àti àwọn àkókò ìdaduro.

entries.englishValueBefore: All Bitcoin transactions are recorded on a public blockchain that anyone can verify and audit.
entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public blockchain anyone can audit. Banks run private ledgers customers can't independently verify.
entries.currentValue: Gbogbo àwọn iṣòwò Bitcoin ni a ń kọ sílẹ̀ lórí blockchain gbangba tí ẹ̀níkaǹkan lè ṣàyẹ̀wò.
entries.targetTranslation: Gbogbo ìṣòwò Bitcoin ni ó wà lórí blockchain tí gbogbo ènìyàn lè ṣàyẹ̀wò. Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ ń ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìwé-ìṣirò àdáni tí àwọn oníbàárà kò lè jẹ́rìí sí lọ́tọ̀.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own private keys and have complete control over your money.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you hold your own private keys — see our simple
entries.currentValue: Pẹ̀lú Bitcoin, o lè mú àwọn kókóró àdání rẹ funrarẹ kí o sì ní àṣẹ kikun lórí owó rẹ.
entries.targetTranslation: Pẹ̀lú Bitcoin, ìwọ ni ó di àwọn kọ́kọ́rọ́ àdáni tirẹ — wo ìtọ́sọ́nà rírọrùn wa lórí

entries.englishValue: guide. Banks hold your money and can freeze, limit, or restrict it at any time.
entries.currentValue: láti lóyé ìṣàkoso-arà. Àwọn ilé-ìfòwópàmó́ máa ń tọ́jú owó rẹ nínú ààkósílẹ̀ wọn àti pé wọn lè dí, tọ̀pọ̀, tàbí ṣe àdéhùn iràyè sí owó rẹ ní àkókó kaǹkaǹ.
entries.targetTranslation: . Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ ni ó di owó rẹ, wọ́n sì lè dí i, díwọ̀n rẹ̀, tàbí kí wọ́n dí i lọ́wọ́ ní àkókò èyíkéyìí.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transaction fees are transparent, predictable, and typically very low. Banks often have hidden fees, monthly account fees, overdraft charges, wire transfer fees, ATM fees, and other penalties that can add up significantly over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin fees are transparent and predictable. Banks stack on hidden account, overdraft, wire, and ATM fees over time.
entries.currentValue: Owó ìsàn iṣòwò Bitcoin gbangba, ó hàn, àti pé ó máa ń kéré púpọ̀. Àwọn ilé-ìfòwópàmó́ sábà máa ń ní owó ìsàn ì̀kòkò, owó ìsàn oṣoọ̀ṣè, àwọn owó ìsàn na-jù, owó ìsàn fífi owó ranṣẹ́, owó ìsàn ATM, àti àwọn ìjìyà mìràn tí ó lè pọ̀ jù pẹ̀lú àkókó.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn iye owó Bitcoin gbangba ni wọ́n sì le ní àsọtẹ́lẹ̀. Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ ń kó owó àpótí, owó ìbo-rírẹ̀, owó ìfiránṣẹ́, àti owó ATM tí ó pamọ́ ṣẹ́gun pẹ̀lú àkókò.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin prevents you from spending money you don't have - you can only spend Bitcoin that you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts (spending more than your account balance) and then charge substantial fees for this 'service,' often leading to cascading penalty charges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin only lets you spend what you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts, then charge cascading penalty fees for the privilege.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin máa ń dá ọ bọ̀ láti na owó tí o kò ní - o lè na Bitcoin tí o ní gídi níkan. Àwọn ilé-ìfòwópàmó́ gba láàyè láti na jù iye tí o wà nínú ààkósílẹ̀ rẹ léyìn náà wọn máa ń gba owó ìsàn pàtàkì fún 'iṣẹ́' yìí, èyí tó sábà máa ń fa àwọn owó ìjìyà púpọ̀.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin nìkan ni ó ń jẹ́ kí o ná ohun tí o ní lóòótọ́. Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ ń gba ìbo-rírẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà wọ́n ń gba owó ìjẹnirò bí ó ti ń jọ̀wọ́ fún àǹfààní náà.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transactions are censorship resistant - once broadcast to the network, they cannot be stopped or reversed by any central authority. Banks can block, freeze, reverse, or restrict transactions based on their policies, government orders, or suspicious activity algorithms.
entries.englishValue: Once broadcast, Bitcoin transactions can't be stopped or reversed. Banks can block, freeze, or reverse transactions based on policy or government orders.
entries.currentValue: Àwọn iṣòwò Bitcoin jẹ́ atàkò ìṣàkoso - nígbà tí a bá fi ranṣẹ́ sí nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì, aláṣẹ ààrìn kò lè da à dúró tàbí yí padà. Àwọn ilé-ìfòwópàmó́ lè dá, dí, yí padà, tàbí ṣe àdéhùn àwọn iṣòwò dá lórí àwọn ofìn wọn, aṣẹ ìkálẹ̀, tàbí àwọn algorithm iṣẹ́ ifúrà.
entries.targetTranslation: Lẹ́yìn ìfiranṣẹ́, àwọn ìṣòwò Bitcoin kò lè dúró tàbí kí ó padà. Àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ lè dí, dí, tàbí kí wọ́n yi àwọn ìṣòwò padà dá lórí ìlànà tàbí àṣẹ ìjọba.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bonds are only 'risk-free' in nominal dollar terms, meaning you'll get your dollars back if you hold to maturity. However, this ignores inflation risk, interest rate risk, and the possibility that those dollars will be worth much less when you get them back.
entries.englishValue: Bonds are only 'risk-free' nominally — inflation, interest-rate moves, and default risk all eat real returns.
entries.currentValue: Àwọn ìfòwólé jẹ́ 'àìlẹ́wù' nínú iye dọ́là níkan, èyí túmọ̀ sí pé iwọ gba dọ́là rẹ padà tí o bá mú à dé àkókó. Ṣùgbọ́n, èyí kò kà ewu owó ṣíṣé, ewu iye elè, àti pé àwọn dọ́là náà lè din iye púpọ̀ nígbà tí o bá gba wọn.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ìfòwó-mu jẹ́ 'aláìní-ewu' nínú orúkọ nìkan — owó-ṣíṣẹ́, ìyípadà ìfowó-yá, àti ewu ìkùnà ń jẹ àwọn èrè gidi run.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has clear, transparent risks (volatility) but no hidden counterparty risk - you either own your Bitcoin or you don't.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has transparent volatility but no hidden counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ní ewu gbangba tó hàn (iyipada) ṣùgbọ́n kò ní ewu alákóṣẹ́ ì̀kòkò - bóyá o ní Bitcoin rẹ tàbí o kò ní í.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ní àìdúró tí ó hàn ṣùgbọ́n kò ní ewu alábàárìn tí ó pamọ́.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is discovered through continuous global markets with no central auction that can fail.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price is discovered continuously on open markets with no central auction that can fail.
entries.currentValue: Iye Bitcoin máa ń jẹ́ ṣàwárí nípà àwọn ọ̀jà àgbáyé tó ń lọ láì dáwódúró láì ní titaja ààrìn kan tó lè kuna.
entries.targetTranslation: Iye Bitcoin ni a ń wádìí léraléra ní àwọn ọjà tí a ṣíi sílẹ̀, láìní ìpolówó àárín tí ó lè kùnà.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bond yields are fixed when you buy them. Even if the economy grows rapidly or the currency devalues significantly, your return stays the same.
entries.englishValue: Bond yields are fixed at purchase. Even if the economy booms or the currency collapses, your return stays the same.
entries.currentValue: Èré ìfòwólé ti wà tèlẹ̀ nígbà tí o bá ra wọn. Pààpàà tí ọ̀rọ̀-ajé bá dàgbà kìyà tàbí owó bá din iye púpọ̀, èré rẹ bakàn náà.
entries.targetTranslation: Èrè ìfòwó-mu ti múlẹ̀ ní rírà. Kódà bí ọrọ̀-ajé bá fẹ́ sí tàbí owó orílẹ̀-èdè bá ṣubú, èrè rẹ máa wà bákan náà.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has the potential for significant appreciation as adoption grows and the fixed supply meets increasing demand.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has room for significant appreciation as adoption grows and demand meets fixed supply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin ní ànfààní ìga iye tó pọ̀ bí gbígbà ṣe ń pọ̀ síì àti ìpese tó wà tèlẹ̀ bá ìbèèrè tó ń pọ̀ síì.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ní ààyè fún ìjẹrè pàtàkì bí ìgbà gbogbo ti ń pọ̀ sí àti bí ìbéèrè ti ń pàdé ìpèsè tí ó múlẹ̀.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, you can take direct ownership through self-custody, eliminating counterparty risk entirely.
