entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn àpò fún àwọn iṣẹ́ tí ó dá lórí ìfilọ́pò

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí o bá ń kọ ìfilọ́pò sí àwọn oníbàárà (ìmọ̀ràn, iṣẹ́-ọ̀fẹ́, àwọn iṣẹ́ B2B), lo àpò tí a kọ́ ní àyíká ìfilọ́pò. Oníbàárà rẹ máa san ìfilọ́pò Bitcoin nínú àwọn tẹ̀ díẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn àpò fún àwọn iṣẹ́ tí ó ní àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ púpọ̀

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí o bá ní ẹgbẹ́ tí ó ń gba àwọn ìsanwó ní àyè-tà, yan àpò tí ó ń ṣe àtìlẹyìn fún àwọn ìwọlé òṣìṣẹ́ púpọ̀ — kí òṣìṣẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan le ní PIN tirẹ kí o sì pa àkọsílẹ̀ àyẹ̀wò mọ́ kíá nípa ẹni tí ó gba ìsanwó wo.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn àpò fún àwọn iṣẹ́ lórí ìntánẹ́ẹ̀tì

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣé o ń tà lórí ojú-ìwé? Àwọn àpò wọ̀nyí ń kàn sínú ilé-ìtàjà rẹ lórí ìntánẹ́ẹ̀tì wọ́n sì ń gba Bitcoin láti ọ̀dọ̀ oníbàárà èyíkéyìí, níbi gbogbo ní àgbáyé — kò sí àwọn chargeback, kò sí àpótí alágbàta tí ó nílò.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn àpò fún àwọn iṣẹ́ tí ó jẹ́ ti ẹnìkan

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí o bá ń ṣe ilé-ìtàjà, ilé-kọfí, studio, tàbí iṣẹ́ fúnra rẹ, èyíkéyìí àpò wọ̀nyí máa ṣiṣẹ́. Yan dá lórí bí o bá fẹ́ pa àwọn ìsanwó mọ́ ní Bitcoin tàbí kí o yí apá ìsanwó kọ̀ọ̀kan padà sí owó àdúgbò rẹ.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business jẹ́ kí o gba àwọn ìsanwó Bitcoin àti Lightning pẹ̀lú odò owó àti ìparí lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Ó ń ṣe àtìlẹyìn fún àwọn ìsanwó lójú-kojú, lórí ìntánẹ́ẹ̀tì, àti dá lórí ìfilọ́pò pẹ̀lú àyàn ìyípadà àdáṣe sí owó àdúgbò rẹ.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Owó kéré, púpọ̀ síi fún iṣẹ́

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ìsanwó Bitcoin fò àwọn ilé-ìfowópamọ́ àti àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ káàdì kírẹ́dítì kọjá tí wọ́n ń gba 2–3% láti gbogbo ìtàjà. Iṣẹ́ ń pa púpọ̀ síi mọ́ nínú ohun tí o sanwó — èyí tí ó sábà jẹ́ àwọn iye tí ó dára àti iṣẹ́ tí ó dára síi fún ọ.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Ìparí lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀, kò sí àwọn chargeback

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ìsanwó Bitcoin pari ní àwọn ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀, tààrà láti àpò rẹ sí iṣẹ́. Kò sí ìdúró fún àwọn ọjọ́ pé ilé-ìfowópamọ́ kan ìtujáde owó, kò sì sí àwọn ìjà chargeback olówó-iyebíye — kí iṣẹ́ lè dojú kọ ìpèsè iṣẹ́ fún àwọn oníbàárà dípò jíja-ìjà-ọrùn-jagunjagun.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Ọ̀fẹ́ láti gba, ṣíṣí sí ẹnikẹ́ni

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Kò sí àwọn àdéhùn, owó oṣù, tàbí àwọn iye ìfìlélẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ kan láti gba Bitcoin. Àwọn mílíọ̀nù olùmúlò Bitcoin ní àgbáyé ń wá àwọn alágbatà tí ó ń gbà — èyí ń fún iṣẹ́ yìí ní ìfihàn ọ̀fẹ́ sí àwọn oníbàárà tuntun.

entries.englishValue: Run a business and want to start accepting Bitcoin?
entries.targetTranslation: Ṣé o ń ṣe iṣẹ́ tí o sì fẹ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ gbígba Bitcoin?

entries.englishValue: See how it works →
entries.targetTranslation: Wo bí ó ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ →

entries.englishValue: Why Bitcoin is great for this business
entries.targetTranslation: Ìdí tí Bitcoin fi dára fún iṣẹ́ yìí

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Gbígba Bitcoin jẹ́ kí iṣẹ́ pa púpọ̀ síi mọ́ láti gbogbo ìtàjà, gba ìsanwó lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ pẹ̀lú odò àwọn chargeback, kí ó sì dé ọwọ́ àwọn olùmúlò Bitcoin àgbáyé — gbogbo rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú odò àdéhùn àti odò owó oṣù.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin kò kàn wúlò ní ààbò olùgbasilẹ — ó jẹ́ ọ̀nà owó tó dára síi tí ó ń dáàbò bo ìfowópamọ́ rẹ, àdáni rẹ, àti òmìnira rẹ láti ṣòwò. Èyí ni ìwòran kíákíá.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: O ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ wo àlèmọ́ Bitcoin Accepted Here. Èyí ni ìdí tí èyí fi jẹ́ ìròyìn dára — fún iṣẹ́ yìí, àti fún ọ.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Iṣẹ́ tí o wà ń gba Bitcoin — nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì ìsanwó òde-òní, orísun-ṣíṣí tí ẹnikẹ́ni lè lò, níbi gbogbo ní àgbáyé, láìní ilé-ìfowópamọ́ tàbí àwọn alábàárìn tí ó gba ìpín.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why accepting Bitcoin is good for this business, plus why using Bitcoin is good for you as a customer.
entries.targetTranslation: Nísàlẹ̀ ni ẹ̀dà kúkúrú ti ìdí tí gbígba Bitcoin fi dára fún iṣẹ́ yìí, pẹ̀lú ìdí tí lílò Bitcoin fi dára fún ọ gẹ́gẹ́ bí oníbàárà.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn ìpolówó jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ọ̀nà tí ó rọrùn jùlọ láti ṣàfihàn Bitcoin sí àyíká rẹ. Ṣe ìgbàsílẹ̀ ìpolówó Bitcoin ọ̀fẹ́ tí a lè tẹ̀, tẹ àwọn ẹ̀dà tí o fẹ́, kí o sì fi wọ́n sí ojú-ìwé àyíká, ní ilé-kọfí, ní àwọn ìpàdé, tàbí ibi mìíràn tí àwọn ènìyàn ń pé.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
entries.targetTranslation: Ìpolówó kọ̀ọ̀kan ní orí ìwé tí ó wúwo àti QR code tí ó rán àwọn olùkà tí wọ́n ní ìfẹ́-mọ̀ sí bitcoin.rocks láti kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ síi.

entries.englishValue: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.

entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.
entries.targetTranslation: bitcoin.rocks jẹ́ iṣẹ́-ìṣẹ̀dá ọ̀fẹ́, orísun-ṣíṣí tí MIT License fi ìwé-àṣẹ rẹ̀ fún. Ètò wa ni láti yára ìgbàfẹ́ Bitcoin nípasẹ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ — a kò sì lè ṣe é nìkan.

entries.englishValue: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí o bá jẹ́ olùṣàfihàn, ọ̀gbọ̀n-ìṣe, akọ̀wé, tàbí olùtumọ̀, ọ̀nà wà fún ọ láti ràn lọ́wọ́. A pàápàá kí àwọn olùṣe-àfikún kí, tí wọ́n lè tumọ̀ àkóónú wa sí àwọn èdè púpọ̀ síi kí àwọn ènìyàn púpọ̀ síi ní àgbáyé lè kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ nípa Bitcoin ní èdè ìbílẹ̀ wọn.

entries.englishValue: Fork the repository, open a pull request, file an issue, or just star the project to show your support. Every contribution helps Bitcoin reach more people.
entries.targetTranslation: Fork repository, ṣíi pull request, fi ọ̀rọ̀ sílẹ̀, tàbí kí o kàn fi ìràwọ̀ sí iṣẹ́ náà láti fi ìtìlẹyìn rẹ hàn. Gbogbo àfikún ń ràn Bitcoin lọ́wọ́ láti dé ọwọ́ àwọn ènìyàn púpọ̀ síi.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn client Nostr jẹ́ àwọn app ọ̀fẹ́ tí ó jẹ́ kí o kà àti pípolówó lórí nẹ́tíwọ́ọ̀kì Nostr. Gbogbo wọn ń bá ara wọn ṣiṣẹ́ — o lè yí client padà ní àkókò èyíkéyìí kí o sì pa àwọn olùtẹ̀lé àti àkóónú rẹ mọ́.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr jẹ́ ìlànà aláìní-àárín tuntun fún ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ lórí ìntánẹ́ẹ̀tì — kò sí ilé-iṣẹ́ kan ṣoṣo tí ó ń darí, a ti kọ́ àwọn zap Bitcoin sínú rẹ̀, o sì lè rin láàárín àwọn app láìpàdánù àwọn olùtẹ̀lé rẹ.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Kíni Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr dàbí ímeèlì: kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó ní ìlànà náà, ẹnikẹ́ni lè kọ́ app sí orí rẹ̀, o sì lè yan app èyíkéyìí tí o fẹ́ jùlọ. Yàtọ̀ sí Twitter tàbí Facebook, kò sí ilé-iṣẹ́ àárín tí ó lè dí ọ lẹ́nu, fa ọ́ kúrò, tàbí kí ó dín ìsọ̀rọ̀ rẹ kù.

Protocol, not platform
entries.targetTranslation: Ìlànà, kì í ṣe àyè

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr jẹ́ ìlànà tuntun tí ó jẹ́ kí o bánisọ̀rọ̀ lórí ìntánẹ́ẹ̀tì láìbẹ̀rù àdílọ́lẹ́, fífà-kúrò, tàbí ìdín-ìsọ̀rọ̀-kù.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Àwọn àyè bíi Twitter àti Facebook ti darí nípasẹ̀ ilé-iṣẹ́ kan, ṣùgbọ́n kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó ń darí ìlànà Nostr.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Òmìnira láti rin

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr dàbí ímeèlì. Kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó ń darí ìlànà ímeèlì, ẹnikẹ́ni sì lè kọ́ client (bíi Gmail, Hotmail, abbl.) sí orí rẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Kò sí ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó ń darí ìlànà Nostr pẹ̀lú, ẹnikẹ́ni sì lè kọ́ client (bíi Damus, Amethyst, abbl.) sí orí rẹ̀.

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Bí o kò bá fẹ́ bí client kan ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́, o lè rọra mú àpótí Nostr rẹ lọ sí client mìíràn láìpàdánù àwọn olùtẹ̀lé tàbí àkóónú rẹ.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: A ti kọ́ Bitcoin sínú

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: A ti kọ́ Bitcoin sínú ìlànà Nostr ní àdámọ̀. Bí o bá rí àkóónú tí o fẹ́, o lè zap Bitcoin sí ẹnikan ní rírọrùn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìdúpẹ́!

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní àwọn àyè àárín bíi Twitter àti Facebook, ilé-iṣẹ́ àárín ń jẹrè owó láti àkóónú rẹ. Ṣùgbọ́n lórí àwọn ìlànà ṣíṣí bíi Nostr, ìwọ ni ó ń jẹrè owó láti àkóónú rẹ.
